label: Batch Plant - Work Order Dispatch
info:
Flow for dispatching batches to the BatchPlant simulator.

Step 1: Post Control Recipe (downloads recipe parameters)
Step 2: Post Work Order (triggers batch execution)

Also includes status and recipe list queries.

name: === BATCH PLANT WORK ORDER DISPATCH ===
info:
Use this flow to send control recipes and work orders to the BatchPlant simulator.

1. Click 'Post Control Recipe' to download the recipe
2. Click 'Post Work Order' to trigger batch execution
3. Use 'Get Status' and 'Get Recipes' to monitor

Default endpoint: http://localhost:5050
